note: Set B is better because it correctly extracts critical engineering values like the hex through bolt length (4") and frame dimensions (2x8"), whereas Set A hallucinates bolt lengths (4.5", 3") and framing sizes (2x4"). Both sets incorrectly hallucinate decking material dimensions not present in the text (A: 2x6x12, B: 5/4x6x12 vs source 3/4x5 1/2), but Set A has significantly more errors binding dimensions to the wrong detail views (e.g., assigning B1 dimensions to C1). Set B demonstrates higher fidelity to the explicit numerical data in the text layer.
